name: Prism Ark Minimini Fandisk "Theresa to Heart"
original_name: プリズム・アーク　ミニミニファンディスク『テレサとハート』
source:
Fandisc includes a mini-story about Sister Hell who won popularity poll among readers. 
After the battle Sister Hell and Fillia continue to live in an orphanage. One day a letter arrives revealing the secret of Fillia's birth...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
资料片收录一篇关于读者人气投票冠军修女赫尔的短篇故事。
战斗结束后，修女赫尔与菲莉娅继续住在孤儿院。某天，一封来信揭开了菲莉娅身世的秘密……

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
